apps.name: RisuNest

versions.localizedDescription:
### New Features

- Applied RisuAI v2026.10.292 changes.
- Added database compaction (reclaims unused SQLite space).

### Improvements

- Changed module imports to leave out MCP settings.
- Allowed plugins to replace other plugins after user confirmation.
- Changed startup text to appear in the device language.
- Allowed plugins to convert to WebP even in environments that do not support WebP conversion.
- Improved restore and storage performance.
- Improved error messages and logging.

### Fixes

- Fixed some API requests, such as Anthropic, being rejected.
- Fixed responses, Lua buttons, and similar work stopping after leaving the app on Android.
- Fixed Google Translate failing with error 429 in some environments.
- Fixed storage growing continuously when plugins repeatedly saved large data.
- Fixed permanent character deletion failing or being reported as failed.
- Fixed RisuAI/PocketRisu compatible exports failing with some settings.
- Fixed some RisuAI modules failing to import.
- Fixed lorebooks and persona descriptions loaded from Lua not reflecting changed variables.
- Fixed Data check failing to fix some issues.
- Fixed the code block menu being hidden behind pop-up windows.

### Breaking Changes

- The sync data format of the Sync server and external storage changes (Sync server update required). After updating every device, switch the format in the sync settings; after the switch, only the same or newer versions can sync with each other.

### New Features

- Added an app lock (if you forget the PIN, you may need to restore your data from a backup).
- Added author's note presets.
- Added binary data support to plugin local storage (getLocalPluginStorage).
- Added a separate permission for plugin tool calls.
- Added a setting that sends only the current chat to plugins (reduces memory usage).

### Improvements

- Changed deleting a character, module, or similar item to also delete its assets.
- Responses being generated are now kept if the app closes.
- Added execution time limits to regex scripts and triggers, and made Lua stop properly on timeout (prevents endless loading).
- Changed desktop downloads to ask for a save location.
- Removed the Keep Session Alive setting (a web-only feature).
- Changed Lua scripts to run in a Worker and CBS to run compiled.
- Improved performance and memory usage of regex, rendering, lorebooks, storage, restores, and more.
- Improved error messages and logging.

### Fixes

- Fixed plugins not loading when the Sync server is unavailable.
- Fixed messages updated by Lua scripts not re-rendering and chat variables not being saved.
- Fixed CSS and plugins that work with the chat screen not finding chat content.
- Fixed YouTube embeds not playing.
- Fixed Google Translate failures and content that could disappear when translation failed.
- Fixed issues with RisuAI account restores and PocketRisu restores.
- Fixed RisuAI/PocketRisu compatible exports failing.
- Fixed Separate Parameters overwriting saved values.
- Fixed S3 and GitHub external storage sync issues.

- Applied RisuAI v2026.10.211 changes.
- Added asset and inlay (chat attachment) galleries.
- Expanded image format support for personas, character icons, and more.
- Improved tasks such as responses and sync to keep running after leaving the app on mobile.
- Added progress and resuming to RisuAI account restores and improved their performance.
- Fixed external storage sync showing as complete before it had finished.
- Optimized memory usage when sending messages in long chats.
- Fixed compatibility issues in some Lua modules (such as Lightboard).
- Fixed a bug where the built-in translator could send translation requests repeatedly.
- Fixed clock and server connection issues in external storage and Sync synchronization.
- Fixed PocketRisu exports not working with some settings.
- Fixed asset bot downloads from Realm and CharX imports not working properly.
- Replaced the Gemini/Gemma tokenizer with the Gemma 4 tokenizer.
- Added a setting for the scroll navigation buttons.
- Changed update checks to run at every app start.
- Improved overall performance of storage, backups, restores, sync, rendering, and startup.
- Improved error messages and logging.

- Fixed RisuAI account backup and restore not working.
- Fixed restore problems with some backup files and improved restore failure notices.
- Fixed backup and sync issues with external storage such as Google Drive, OneDrive, and GitHub.
- Added a UI and popups that show sync status and errors.
- Added a feature that delays loading plugins until sync has fully finished (prevents plugin data corruption).
- Fixed and improved Sync server synchronization.
- Added CBS parsing for plugins (parseRisuChat).
- Improved plugin storage compatibility (fixed storing Date objects).
- Improved conversation loading performance with long chats or many assets.
- Fixed bugs in automatic input translation, toggle presets, and lorebooks.
- Fixed a bug that could navigate the RisuNest app to an external page.
- Fixed and improved file downloads on all platforms, including plugin file downloads.
- Improved the Windows installer.
- Improved error messages and logging.

- Fixed failures when restoring RisuAI and PocketRisu backups.
- Fixed large backups failing to restore on Android.
- Fixed backups with 200,000 or more assets failing to restore.
- Improved backup restores and Sync/external storage restores to show progress.
- Improved restore and sync performance.
- Fixed toggle changes being saved automatically when using toggle binding.
- Fixed the scroll position jumping when message heights change.
- Added support for Voyage Context 4 embeddings.
- Raised the local plugin storage limit.
- Fixed file selection not working properly on iOS.
- Improved AltStore integration on iOS and fixed signatures not being passed to the IPA file.
- Added multiple profiles on desktop through `--profile=<name>`.
- Added multiple languages and an architecture check to the Windows installer.
- Improved automatic updates, installation, and removal on Windows.

- Improved compatibility with bots, modules, and plugins.
- Improved Lua, script, and UI performance in long chats.
- Added a console log viewer.
- Fixed update links not opening on Android.
- Fixed a sidebar scrolling issue on iOS.
